about: Companies House public register (UK): search companies, officers and disqualified directors, and read company profiles, filing history, officers, PSCs, charges, officer appointments, dissolved and alphabetical company searches, name availability, advanced search with CSV export, and filing document PDFs.

commands.summary: Search companies and officers together by keyword. Results are mixed; the item class is type-company or type-officer.

params.name: q
params.description: Search keyword: a company name, company number or person name

commands.summary: Search companies by name or number. Returns name, profile URL, company number, incorporation or dissolution date and address.

params.name: page
params.description: Result page number (20 results per page)

params.name: searchType
params.description: Set to 'dissolved' to search dissolved companies

commands.summary: Search company officers (directors, secretaries, corporate officers) by name. Returns links to each officer's appointments.

params.name: q
params.description: Officer name. Can include a location filter, e.g. John Smith location:"CF14"

params.name: page
params.description: Result page number (20 results per page)

commands.summary: Search disqualified directors by name. Returns links to each disqualification detail page.
Get disqualification details for a person or company: date of birth, nationality, disqualification type, start and end dates, case reference, companies involved and reason.

params.name: kind
params.description: 'natural' for a person, 'corporate' for a company. Take it from the search result URL.

params.name: officerId
params.description: Disqualified officer id, the last segment of the URL returned by search-disqualified-officers

commands.summary: Get a company overview by company number: name, registered office address, status, SIC code and previous names.

params.name: companyNumber
params.description: 8-character company number, with leading zeros or a prefix such as SC or NI, e.g. 00445790

commands.summary: List a company's filing history (date, type, description, PDF link), optionally filtered by category. Paginated.

params.name: category
params.description: Filing category filter, e.g. accounts, confirmation-statement, officers, capital, mortgage, incorporation, resolution, address, persons-with-significant-control

commands.summary: Download a filing document PDF. The server redirects to a signed S3 URL.

params.name: transactionId
params.description: Filing transaction id, the path segment after /filing-history/ in a documentUrl from list-filing-history

params.name: download
params.description: 1 to force a download (attachment), 0 to view inline

commands.summary: List a company's officers (directors and secretaries) with role, appointment date, date of birth and links to their appointments.

params.name: filter
params.description: Set to 'active' to show only current officers

commands.summary: List a company's persons with significant control (owners and controllers), or the reason the company is exempt.
List a company's registered charges (mortgages and security agreements), with links to each charge's details.
Get one charge's details: type, created and delivered dates, status, filing transaction with PDF link, and persons entitled.

params.name: chargeId
params.description: Charge id, the last segment of a URL from list-company-charges

commands.summary: List all company appointments held by one officer: company, company status, role, appointed and resigned dates, correspondence address.

params.name: officerId
params.description: Officer id from a search-officers or list-company-officers URL (/officers/{id}/appointments)

params.name: filter
params.description: Set to 'active' to show only current appointments

commands.summary: Advanced company search. Filter by name include/exclude, registered office address, incorporation and dissolution date ranges, status, SIC code and company type. Returns company names and profile URLs

params.name: companyNameIncludes
params.description: Company name must contain this text

params.name: companyNameExcludes
params.description: Exclude company names containing this text

params.name: registeredOfficeAddress
params.description: Full or partial registered office address

params.name: sicCodes
params.description: SIC nature-of-business code, e.g. 10710 (bread and fresh pastry)

params.name: type
params.description: Company type code, e.g. ltd, plc, llp, private-unlimited, private-limited-guarant-nsc

commands.summary: Download advanced company search results as CSV, using the same filters as advanced-search-companies.

params.name: companyNameIncludes
params.description: Company name must contain this text

params.name: companyNameExcludes
params.description: Exclude company names containing this text

params.name: registeredOfficeAddress
params.description: Full or partial registered office address

params.name: type
params.description: Company type code, e.g. ltd, plc, llp

commands.summary: Search companies dissolved since 1989 by their name at dissolution or by a previous name.

params.name: changedName
params.description: Match the name at dissolution, or match previous names

params.name: searchType
params.description: Set to 'alphabetical' to list results alphabetically. Numbers and previous names are unavailable in this mode.

commands.summary: Browse the register alphabetically around a company name (40 rows per page). Returns name, number and status. Uses cursor paging via searchAfter/searchBefore.

params.name: companyName
params.description: Company name to start browsing from

params.name: searchAfter
params.description: Next-page cursor: the last row's name, uppercase with no spaces or punctuation, plus ':' and the company number, e.g. TESCOBARBERSWOOD:07137692

params.name: searchBefore
params.description: Previous-page cursor: the first row's name in the same format as searchAfter

commands.summary: Check whether a proposed company name is available by listing existing companies with the same or similar names.
